text.id: Kita nyari di dermaga utama. Di homestay-homestay. Di Pantai Pasir Perawan, yang isinya cuma turis yang selfie sama sisa badai.
text.en: We search the main jetty. The homestays. Pasir Perawan beach, where there's nobody but tourists taking selfies with what the storm left behind.

text.id: Jam delapan, kapal polisi merapat di dermaga kecil di timur, di sebelah bakau. Kita lari ke sana. Kita nyampe pas dua polisi nuntun Pak Hendra turun dari kapal biru-putih, tangannya di depan.
text.en: At eight, the police boat docks at the small jetty in the east, by the mangroves. We run there. We arrive just as two officers lead Pak Hendra off a blue and white boat, his hands in front of him.

text.id: Di rumah di ujung dermaga, kasurnya masih anget. Kata sepupu Pak Hendra, perempuan berjaket hijau pergi jam tujuh. Naik perahu nelayan, waktu ada yang lihat kapal polisi di cakrawala.
text.en: In the house at the end of the jetty, the mattress is still warm. Pak Hendra's cousin says the woman in the green jacket left at seven. On a fishing boat, when someone saw the police boat on the horizon.

text.id: Satu jam. Gue telat satu jam.
text.en: An hour. I was an hour late.

text.id: Di dermaga, ada laki-laki pake batik yang disetrika rapi, megang payung padahal nggak hujan. Dia senyum ke gue kayak orang yang udah lama kenal.
text.en: On the jetty there's a man in a neatly ironed batik shirt, holding an umbrella though it isn't raining. He smiles at me like someone who's known me a long time.

text.id: Mas Raka. Akhirnya. Sayang sekali Mbak Sekar-nya nggak ada. Tapi penculiknya sudah ketemu.
text.en: Raka. At last. A pity Ms. Sekar isn't here. But her kidnapper has been found.

text.id: Printout email Bima ada di tas Tasya.
text.en: Bima's printout of the email is in Tasya's bag.
(Give the email to the police. Now.)

text.id: Polisinya baca dua kali. Dari Rudy Hartono, bos Bima. Untuk Aditya Nugraha. "Sekar A. pegang salinan AMDAL asli + rekaman orang dinas. Mohon ditangani dengan bijak." Dikirim tiga minggu sebelum Sekar hilang.
text.en: The officer reads it twice. From Rudy Hartono, Bima's boss. To Aditya Nugraha. "Sekar A. has a copy of the original AMDAL + a recording of someone from the office. Please handle it wisely." Sent three weeks before Sekar vanished.

text.id: Didit nggak senyum lagi. Pak Hendra dilepas sebelum siang, dengan catatan "wajib lapor". Laporan penculikannya "akan ditinjau ulang".
text.en: Didit stops smiling. Pak Hendra is let go before noon, ordered to report in. The kidnapping report "will be reviewed".

text.id: Gue nggak punya apa-apa buat dikasih ke polisi. Cuma cerita, dan cerita nggak bisa ngelepasin borgol.
text.en: I've got nothing to give the police. Only a story, and a story can't open handcuffs.
